The creature dies normally at 0 HP; disabling organs does not unmake it. The remaining organs retain their own counters.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: It makes 3 Province Bite attacks.

action.name: Province Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 20 ft. {@h}62 ({@damage 8d12 + 10}) Force damage.

action.name: The Country Closes {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 26}, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 20-foot-wide Line. {@actSaveFail} 77 ({@damage 14d10}) Force damage and the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. When its furnace organ is broken, this attack’s damage is 55 ({@damage 10d10}).

bonus.name: Fear Hunger
entries: If this emotion’s organ has been broken by Divided Body, this ability cannot be used. {@actSave wis} {@dc 26}, one creature it can see within 30 feet that can see or hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition of this monster until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this monster’s Fear Hunger until the start of its next turn.

bonus.name: Grief Hunger
entries: If this emotion’s organ has been broken by Divided Body, this ability cannot be used. {@actSave con} {@dc 26}, one creature it has damaged this turn that it can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. If the target has fewer than half its maximum HP, it also has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for that duration. An adjacent ally can use an action to end one of these conditions caused by this ability.

bonus.name: Rage Hunger
entries: If this emotion’s organ has been broken by Divided Body, this ability cannot be used. It chooses a creature within 10 feet that it can see. That creature can use its Reaction to make one melee attack against the monster with Advantage. The creature can refuse. If the attack deals damage, it creates this monster’s rage feeding trigger. This ability grants no additional attacks to the monster itself.

bonus.name: Envy Hunger
entries: If this emotion’s organ has been broken by Divided Body, this ability cannot be used. {@actSave dex} {@dc 26}, one other creature it can see within 60 feet with the highest current HP among other creatures it can see in that range. On a tie the monster chooses one of the tied creatures. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. An adjacent ally can use an action to break the visible binding, ending Restrained. Its attacks against other creatures can break a current-HP tie and establish a feeding target.

bonus.name: Longing Hunger
entries: If this emotion’s organ has been broken by Divided Body, this ability cannot be used. {@actSave str} {@dc 26}, one Large or smaller creature it can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The monster pulls the target up to 35 feet directly toward itself through an unobstructed path, ending in an unoccupied space. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. The target then has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 26}) until the start of the monster’s next turn from a visible tether. The monster can maintain only one such tether; a new one ends the old one. An adjacent creature can use an action to break the tether.

legendaryHeader: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature’s turn, it can expend uses to take one of the following actions. It cannot do so while Incapacitated. It regains all expended uses at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Territorial Step
entries: It moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If it has a Fly Speed, it can use that speed instead. Grappled or Restrained still prevents this movement.

legendary.name: Claim the Ground
entries: It chooses one 10-foot square on a surface it can see within 60 feet. That square becomes visibly Difficult Terrain for creatures other than this monster until the start of its next turn. It can maintain only one square at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

legendary.name: Punish the Trespass (Costs 2 Uses)
entries: It makes one Province Bite attack. This attack cannot activate the once-on-its-turn damage or extra-attack feedings.
